adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts the new DB fallback fetches a credential via prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } }) and then passes that raw credential object to getCalendar(calendarCredential). Unlike the similar fallback logic added in EventManager (which includes app: { select: { slug:true } } and maps it into a CredentialWithAppName containing appName), this path does not attach appName. Given the diff shows createEvent/getCalendar plumbing now relies on CredentialWithAppName/credential.appName elsewhere, this mismatch can cause getCalendar to fail to resolve the calendar service and skip deletions.
